Rustler is part of 9 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (3), [Web](@/projects/web.md) (2), [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1).

Most recently: [astudo](@/work/astudo.md); [korczis.gitlab.io](@/work/korczis-gitlab-io.md); [meili\_rsex](@/work/meili-rsex.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Rustler: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Rustler to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
